description: This file defines an abstract class `DisabledTransactionsTestRunner` that extends `TransactionTestRunnerBase` to provide testing functionality related to disabled transactions within the Orleans framework. It includes methods to verify that certain grain operations throw `OrleansTransactionsDisabledException` when transactions are disabled.

classes.name: DisabledTransactionsTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class for testing scenarios where transactions are disabled, ensuring grains throw appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: TransactionGrainsThrowWhenTransactions
methods.description: Tests that a single grain throws `OrleansTransactionsDisabledException` when attempting to perform a transaction.

methods.name: MultiTransactionGrainsThrowWhenTransactions
methods.description: Tests that multiple grains coordinated by a transaction coordinator throw `OrleansTransactionsDisabledException` when attempting to perform a multi-grain transaction.
